# Embedded PLMN data

`src-java/jspectrumanalyzer/iq/plmn.csv` is a compact snapshot derived from
`pbakondy/mcc-mnc-list`, retrieved on 2026-07-20. The upstream project is
distributed under the MIT License; its license text is preserved in
`plmn-data-LICENSE.txt`. Upstream identifies the Wikipedia Mobile Country Code
tables as its data source.

The numerical MCC/MNC identification plan is defined by ITU-T E.212. Operator
names and assignment status can change after this application snapshot.
